name: Pulse Health
audience: Adults 25-45, busy, health-curious, not medical professionals

tone.summary: Warm, calm, evidence-based. A kind doctor friend, never alarmist.
do: Plain words; explain any medical term in the same sentence
One clear, doable action per Reel
Say 'talk to a doctor' when symptoms are involved
dont: Fear hooks, shock statistics without a source, or shaming

character.name: Dr. Ira
character.description: Friendly male doctor in teal scrubs, short dark hair, warm smile, stethoscope around neck, chest-up framing, soft cream background.
character.outfit: Teal scrubs (#0F7C7E), white undershirt collar, silver stethoscope
character.framing: Chest-up, centred, eyes at upper third, never cropped below the top safe zone

voice.style: ElevenLabs Eric (smooth, trustworthy, American male). Warm, mid-pace (~150 wpm), calm emphasis

compliance.disclaimer: Not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about your health.
